description: You are an Electronics Engineer designing a custom aluminum heatsink for a high-power H-bridge motor driver module rated at 100W continuous dissipation. The heatsink must mount a TO-220 power package. The TO-220 JEDEC standard specifies: 15.9mm x 10.15mm flat mounting surface, with one 3.5mm diameter mounting hole centered 5.08mm from the package body edge (the standard TO-220 mounting hole position). The heatsink must maximize surface area to dissipate the rated power into still air. Use a standard fin-and-base extrusion profile: a flat aluminum base plate to which a regular array of fins is attached. The fin array must have at least 8 fins. The entire heatsink design must be parametric: fin count, fin height, fin thickness, and base plate thickness must all be defined as named parameters in a central table so that the design can be optimized for different thermal targets without redrawing. Include at least 2 mounting holes (M3 minimum clearance) for attaching the heatsink assembly to a PCB or chassis plate. Log in as ga / password123. Save the parametric model to /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/heatsink.FCStd, export to STL at /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/heatsink.stl, and export to STEP at /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/heatsink.step.
